    Key Catalog

    Open Tools > UI Navigation > Key Catalog to manage Database addresses shared by UXML, graphs, and code. The catalog is an Editor authoring registry; runtime matching uses serialized values.

    Catalogs

    Tab Used by
    View NavElement, UI Show/Hide commands, and UI View outputs
    Toggle NavToggle, Toggle outputs, and Toggle Portal conditions
    Signal NavButton, Signal.Send(UIKey), Signal outputs, Send Signal, and Signal Portals

    Every Database address is a case-sensitive Category / Key pair. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed. Custom Signals are graph-local strings and are intentionally not registered in the catalog.

    Workflow

    1. Add a Category and Key in the correct tab.
    2. Assign it from a UI Builder or Graph Inspector picker.
    3. Use Scan Project to discover addresses in UXML and .uinavgraph assets.
    4. Use Refresh Usage to update reference counts without modifying the catalog.

    Scanning does not parse arbitrary C# strings. Register code-only Database addresses manually. Rename previews and updates supported UXML and graph references together; deleting only removes the catalog entry and leaves serialized usages intact.

    The catalog is stored at ProjectSettings/UITKNavigationKeyCatalog.asset. Commit it with the assets that use it. It is not included in player builds.
